climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A district in the Coastal Region of the Western Cape, containing Simonsberg-Paarl, Voor Paardeberg and Wellington. Chenin Blanc leads plantings at 19%, followed by Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon and Pinotage.
